name.fr-FR: Opuscules de saint François de Sales, tome XXII
name.en-US: Opuscules of St. Francis de Sales, vol. XXII
name.pt-BR: Opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales, tomo XXII

description.fr-FR: Les opuscules du tome XXII de l’édition d’Annecy : Études et vie intime (cours de philosophie et de droit, règles pour la sainte communion, Exercices spirituels de Padoue, notes de théologie, poésies, testaments) et les écrits du début de l’apostolat dans le Chablais.
description.en-US: The opuscules in volume XXII of the Annecy edition: studies and inner life (philosophy and law notes, rules for Holy Communion, the Padua spiritual exercises, theology notes, verse, wills) and the writings of the early Chablais mission.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales no tomo XXII da edição de Annecy (Première et deuxième séries).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. XXII: Opuscules, 1925 (file 22), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original spelling (and the Latin or Italian of some pieces), extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references, the variants and footnotes, and the editors’ introductions and tables are not included. Chapters follow the printed section headings; short sections are folded into the preceding chapter under a second-level heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
